whyMatters.en: Seattle grunge band that outlasted the early-90s boom as a touring and Ticketmaster-fight institution; Ten (1991) remains the mass entry.
whyMatters.zh: 西雅图 grunge：在 90 年代初热潮后仍以巡演与 Ticketmaster 抗争体制存续；Ten（1991）仍是大众入口。

shortBio.en: Vedder-fronted grunge; Alive and Jeremy define the debut-era radio face.
shortBio.zh: Vedder 领衔的 grunge；Alive 与 Jeremy 定义出道期电台面孔。

body.en:
Formed 1990 from Green River/Mother Love Bone fragments with Eddie Vedder. Ten and Vs. made them stadium-scale alongside Nirvana/Soundgarden; Vitalogy onward tracked a longer career arc.

Alive (1991) is the essential-track marker here. Musically: open chords, McCready leads, Vedder’s baritone. Institutionally: anti-scalping fights and bootleg-heavy touring culture.
body.zh:
1990 年由 Green River/Mother Love Bone 碎片与 Eddie Vedder 组建。Ten 与 Vs. 使其与 Nirvana/Soundgarden 同级体育场体量；Vitalogy 起进入更长职业弧线。

Alive（1991）是此处必听标记。音乐上：开放和弦、McCready 主音、Vedder 男中音。制度上：反黄牛斗争与重现场录音的巡演文化。
